_note: Interior sets for the previs, read by art/previs/render.py (a shot's "set") and explorer.html. `at`: where the set's origin (the centre of its floor) sits in explorer coords [x, y, z]; `carve`: the radius (m) round it within which the island model's own building is cut away, from `carve_above` m over the floor up. Build a set with blender -b -P art/sets/<name>.py; the GLBs are local only.
